name: Parker Cole
degree: Bachelor of Science, Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering
intro: I design, build, and iterate physical prototypes — connecting CAD, manufacturing, and hands-on engineering.
bio: I'm a Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering student at Oklahoma State University with a Mathematics minor. I enjoy turning concepts into physical hardware, then working through the details that make a design practical to build and assemble.

My work spans custom putter prototypes in SolidWorks and advanced manufacturing engineering at Peterbilt. I'm looking for engineering internship opportunities where I can contribute to design, manufacturing, and prototyping while continuing to develop my technical skills.

points: Supported the Chassis Powertrain and Cab & Outer Body groups across multiple engineering projects.
Created and modified 3D models in Creo in a production manufacturing environment.
Developed an AI-assisted drawing information tool; reduced a recurring task from approximately 5 to 1 minute per drawing.
Presented progress weekly and delivered a final presentation to engineering leadership.
Promoted from Mover to Navigator within two weeks.
Planned truck layouts and coordinated with teammates and customers to complete moves safely and on schedule.
Managed inventory, product placement, and restocking while assisting customers and supporting store operations.
